notes.title: Picture Perfect Update OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello fishing friends! 🎣

Exciting news: The free Picture Perfect Update has officially docked into Moonglow Bay - now available on all platforms!

The update is packed with fresh new features that will help you become the ultimate fish-fluencer. You can look forward to:

A new camera mode that'll let you capture all the stunning sights of Moonglow Bay from angles you've never seen before. And yes you can take selfies with Waffles! 📷

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171056/0ee79e51fef24d6aa95fc06f02a5477487f8ddbe.png

Storefront decorations! You’ll now be able to decorate that shabby shop of yours to make it look primed for sales. Choose from a variety of styles to find the look that suits you! ✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171056/f1a2da42e99886382a408c45ff3ba078fdef42b7.png

A mysterious new quest line that will take you to all corners of the ocean - it's sure to reel you right in! 👀

The update also includes a variety of fixes to make your Moonglow experience even better! Read the full patch notes here.

Want to see more? Check out the full trailer right here:

[previewyoutube=50Rl5mpPwqc;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you enjoy the new update and we’d also like to say a big welcome to our Playstation and Switch players! We can’t wait to see you all in the Bay!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Of course, don’t forget to follow us on Twitter and join our Discord to stay up to date on the latest updates and news! See you soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 1.1.12.0
notes.content:
Hello friends, we hope you’ve been enjoying the free Picture Perfect Update that was released today! In addition to some exciting new content, the update also comes with some more fixes to create an even smoother gameplay experience.

As always, thank you all for your patience and for continuing to share your feedback with us! 

Update 1.1.12.0 includes the following fixes/changes:


 Added a note on the Civic Restoration task, indicating that 'Renovate the Library' must be completed before proceeding. The quest marker for the library is still visible but can be untracked.

 Fixed issue where shops were unmanned after the centennial festival.

 Fixed bug where the release UI appeared after catching or releasing a fish.

 Corrected issue where shoreline patterns were visible in the middle of the ocean.

 Resolved bug where water sound effects were heard when using the net on the sand.

 Fixed issue where two ice birds were floating in the air.

 Debris is no longer visible after collection.

 Fixed bug where player clipped through the Dinghy during blueprint cutscene.

 Addressed issue where equipment and catch UI overlapped when both players were fishing in Co-Op mode. Now, gear can only be accessed if both players are not fishing.

 Boat collision with the middle of land in cloud zone fixed. Additionally, cloud areas around the edges are now properly adjusted.


Minor Fixes
Various collisions around the game world have been corrected to reduce possibilities of clipping out or falling through the terrain.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you encounter any further issues in-game, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us via the Steam Community Hub, social media, or Discord! Thank you and we hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Picture Perfect Update and Playstation/Switch Port Coming to Moonglow!
notes.content:
Hey there, fellow anglers! 🎣

Exciting news awaits! On April 11th, Moonglow Bay will be setting sail for PlayStation and Switch, and we couldn't be more thrilled to welcome our new friends to the Bay!

But hold onto your fishing rods because there's more! Alongside this big launch, we're delighted to announce The Picture Perfect Update, coming to all platforms on April 11th. This update is packed with fresh content - get ready for:


 A new camera mode that'll let you capture all the stunning sights of Moonglow Bay from angles you've never seen before.
 A mysterious new quest line that will take you to all corners of the ocean - it's sure to reel you right in!

So, mark your calendars, grab your tackle box, and get ready to dive into the new content on April 11th!

[previewyoutube=50Rl5mpPwqc;full][/previewyoutube]

Don’t forget to follow us on Twitter and join our Discord to stay up to date on the latest updates and news! See you soon!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7 out on Steam with more to come
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171056/b1cb01847d33994b4846c0b40c4418658aa5a93f.png

Thank you everyone for your patience. We’re releasing this patch to address the more prominent issues we’ve heard from the community, namely bugs causing players to lose progress.

51 total fixes:


 A handful of soft-lock “stuck” fixes
 22 collision fixes for the world, Boat shouldn’t be getting stuck in places as much and player won’t fall through the world
 Ocean Door Quest marker location updated to better reflect the quest completion requirements
 Added flash warning and controller recommendation to the splashscreen
 Reminder that you can turn off flashing effects in the options menu
 Ice fishing bug corrected. You can fish in holes you’ve dug
 You can recover your scooter after pressing “Help, I’m Stuck!”
 Song of the Sea quest triggers properly making for a smoother progression
 Rebinding inputs cleaned up (can't get locked out)
 10+ minor updates improving UX when fishing and toggling through bait/rods.


Expect another update in the future to address other minor bugs brought to the team. We are not done with Moonglow Bay and will be updating you soon with what’s to come!

notes.title: Moonglow Bay 1.06 now shipping out with additional tweaks and fixes
notes.content:
⛵ Hey friends, hope you’ve been enjoying Moonglow Bay 1.05. ⛵

Following on from this, we’ve made some further tweaks to the game to improve the overall experience as well as address some of your individual concerns.

Update 1.06 includes the following updates:


 A collision has been adjusted on North Beach so your net will no longer get stuck in the sand when catching sand fleas

Thank you for continuing to share your gameplay experiences with us. If you’re still experiencing any issues with the game, please let us know below, via the Moonglow Bay Social Media Channels or on the Steam Forums.🎣

notes.title: Update 1.04 now rolling out for Moonglow Bay!
notes.content:
Today, we’re rolling out update 1.04 on Steam which further fixes some of the issues you’ve been experiencing.

You’ve been reporting an issue where save data could break when connecting a controller during the splash screens. This has now been fixed.

We’ve also updated some of the cutscenes in Chapter 5 where text was missing and the Options Menu will no longer default to English after rebooting the game in a different language

We’re sorry if you’ve been affected by any issues during your playthrough of Moonglow Bay, we hope this update will make your experience more seamless and enjoyable as we’ve made further performance improvements.

Update 1.04 is replicated on EGS, also available from today, and we anticipate other platforms will receive planned updates in March, before the end of Q1.

Thank you for your continued patience and support.

notes.title: Catch This Now on Steam!
notes.content:
Firstly, we wanted to reassure you that we’re continually listening to your feedback and there will be further updates for Moonglow Bay in the near future.

Until then, we’re excited to let you know that we’ve just added unique emoticons, backgrounds, badges, and trading cards through Steam!

Each asset celebrates the game through its characters, settings and items and all are available to unlock from today!

In total there are…


 10 Emoticons (Made up of 5 Common, 4 Uncommon and 1 Rare)
 3 Backgrounds (1 Common, 1 Uncommon, 1 Rare)
 5 Badges
 1 Foil Badge
 15 Trading Cards

Let us know your favourites and if you manage to unlock them all. We hope you enjoy them!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171056/fa5e4bf9b1ce6440e5ed2ef349d293d0ca3c0dd1.png


In case you missed it, Moonglow Bay has now been updated to version 1.0.3 on Steam so the game includes many of the fixes and features you’ve been asking for, such as rebindable controls, mouse and keyboard support, autosaving, and a help I’m stuck button which can often get you out a jam. This update is also reflected on the Epic Games Store. 

For those playing on other platforms, there are updates in the works and we hope to share more information on those in the very near future. You can get more information here in the meantime but be sure to stay tuned to the Moonglow Bay social channels for all the latest updates.

Thanks to everyone who has commented, streamed, reviewed, and sent us feedback about your experiences in the Bay. We read everything and are so very grateful for your support.  

Sea you out there!

notes.title: New Major Update 1.0.3 is here!
notes.content:
New Major Update 1.0.3 brings mouse and rebindable keyboard and controller support to Moonglow Bay + much more.


Available from today, we’re really excited to roll out Moonglow Bay 1.0.3 to further address some of the concerns and issues you’ve been reporting.

Ever since we launched back on October 26, we’ve been listening intently to your feedback and working hard behind the scenes to refine, polish, and optimise Moonglow Bay to make the experience as good as it can be. 

Two of the biggest concerns we’ve heard from you is the lack of keyboard and mouse functionality and the option to remap your control scheme. With this update, we’re delighted to say that both are now possible!

1.0.3 also includes updates to the game’s UI, an improved cooking bar for the boiling minigame, as well as various character specific and gameplay tweaks and adjustments.

You can see the full changelog here…

Features

Added mouse along with the existing keyboard controls
Controller, and keyboard + mouse controls are now fully rebindable! It can be found  under the Options menu

Main Menu / UI

Able to navigate menus using the D-pad
Able to navigate shop UI with controller bumpers
Expanded Options menu; More added to Audio and Graphics
“Show/hide completed” preference in Task journal is saved permanently.
Adjusted the page scrolling to carrousel through items
Able to hold down to navigate sections of the journal and when adding or removing multiple items when selecting quantity
Fixed an issue where hidden tasks remained hidden when there were no active tasks in the journal
Improvements to the Boiling minigame
Other minor updates to the UI

Gameplay

Your boat, the Two Cats, can now be docked at the marina docks, by the Aquarium 
You can’t enter the Two Cats anymore if it’s fully damaged
The dinghy now moves even if the Two Cats is fully damaged 
Players will no longer fall through the door of the cabin 
No more soft blocking if attempting to assist while collecting fish from a net, during co-op
Once the Two Cats is fixed, you can now board it at the Boat Shop
Restaurateur achievement unlocks only when all requirements are reached
Dinghy now won’t ever sink


Spoilers Ahead!



Chapter 1:

If you return to town during the encounter with the Ruin of Ships, its soundtrack will no longer disappear forever
River won’t get stuck when you save and quit during the lobster trap tutorial
Lobster tutorial will now progress when starting it alongside the purchase of a boat upgrade

Chapter 2:

When you open the Ocean Doors and you go to the Twintail Lake straight away, the Ouellette Twins will show at their correct location
The dinghy’s acceleration won’t build up and shoot forward if the map is open or the game was paused while over water currents in the Hot Springs

Chapter 4:

No longer able to enter the Crystal Squid’s den before its encounter 
The Crystal Squid will now release the trash piles during co-op as well

Chapter 5:

Fishing line no longer snaps immediately in the Astral Planes while casting to the furthest distance possible 
The Two Cats won’t fly in the sky anymore

Help! I'm Stuck
Option of "Help! I'm Stuck" no longer available in the following situations:

Before answering the door to River
Before getting the journal
During the trash clean up task
During fishing tutorial with River
Before the ice fishing tutorial
During the Crystal Squid encounter


We know our Xbox / Game Pass players are still waiting patiently for more updates and those are still being worked on and are forthcoming. Please stay tuned to our social media channels for all the latest news. 

We’ve been overwhelmed by the ‘Very Positive’ Steam review sentiment over the past 30 days and are delighted to see many of the issues you’ve cited have been addressed. We hope this patch will go a step further in making the experience even better for everyone. 

If you haven’t already, and are having a great time in Moonglow Bay, we’d really appreciate it if you could leave a review on Steam to tell us more about your experiences. 

Thank you so much for all your messages and support over the past two months. We sincerely apologise for any issues you may have experienced while playing the game and we truly hope this update provides the level of support you’ve been looking for.

notes.title: New Patch Incoming!
notes.content:
Hi all,

It’s been a week since we launched Moonglow Bay and we’re grateful for all of your support and feedback. We’ve been listening intently to every word and working hard to fix as many of the issues you’re experiencing as possible. 

Today, we’re excited to share there’s a new patch rolling out which, among other things, includes an option for V-Sync, has improved keyboard controls, and auto-save! 

Please keep your feedback coming in as we’re continuing to work hard behind the scenes on the game and if you’ve already been spending some time in the Bay, perhaps you’ll consider leaving us a review. We’d really appreciate it.

Thank you!

v 1.0.2
Patch notes 


The game will now auto-save when the player sleeps
Improved keyboard controls
‘Help! I’m Stuck’ has been added to the pause menu, which sends the player to a safe area if stuck in the environment. 
V-Sync added to the options menu
Save/Load button prompts no longer spillover the borders of the screen
Boat repair items sold in the Boat Shop are now locked until the boat is unlocked
Player's extra vending machine, which becomes available later in the game, is now fully visible
Quick time events during the Ruin of Ships’ encounter no longer fail instantly
All active controllers are now assigned to Player 1 until co-op is activated
Co-op can now be played with one keyboard and one controller
Co-op now only starts by selecting it through the pause menu and pressing the requested key/button. The controller that presses it becomes Player 2
Ramp added to the small beach behind the player's home
Door will now open before River walks through it during her first cutscene
Cozy Cavern recovered its ramps
Chipmunk now plays its animations
Other minor issues addressed


Spoilers:

Chapter 5: Final transmitter can only be placed once its quest is active
Chapter 2: The Storm Fish only visible when its quest is active

notes.title: Moonglow Bay setting sail later than expected on October 26, 2021
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171056/c706df3499674d610c9148f01555df6952e51af7.jpg

Moonglow Bay setting sail later than expected on October 26, 2021.

Publisher Coatsink and developers Bunnyhug are unfortunately announcing Moonglow Bay, the story-driven ‘slice-of-life' fishing RPG will be departing the bay a little later than expected due to additional development time needed to ensure the best possible experience.  

Originally planned to release October 7th, Moonglow Bay will now be setting sail on October 26th 2021.

[previewyoutube=EpKl2ETxnY4;full][/previewyoutube]

The team have been building an enriching world full of things to see and do, and from day one the intention was always to create an experience that is lasting, making Moonglow Bay the absolute best place to visit. In order to truly deliver on that vision, it has been determined that we need to shift our launch date.

However, we still want to share more of Moonglow Bay before release day so we’ll have something new to show you on October 7th. Please look out for it across our social channels!

“The game is delayed, but not by much!

We at Bunnyhug have been working on Moonglow Bay for 4 years alongside Coatsink to make the best experience possible.

Sadly, over the last few weeks we’ve been encountering some pesky bugs which have made getting a clean release build difficult.

The game is now in a good place and in the final stage of development, but still needs to pass the final hurdles, so to ensure all is right as rain, we’ll be releasing Moonglow Bay on October 26! 

We hope you can enjoy what’s coming!”  -  The Bunnyhug team 

The community that has grown around our game make us smile and laugh every day. You’ve given us all the motivation to deliver something truly special and we are ever grateful for your support

While we appreciate this news will be disappointing to hear, we hope you’ll still embark on this journey with us in just a few weeks time.

Bunnyhug and Coatsink
